title: The out-of-the-box Parts Manager role can open Credit Terms and move customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as user A, on the out-of-the-box "Parts Manager" role, reset to its template.
  • Make sure at least one customer holds Net 30.
  • Start on the Settings page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Credit Terms" in the Finance group.
  2. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  3. Hover "Move Customers".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Credit Terms page opens on the Active tab.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Move Customers" in normal (not greyed) text.

Step 3:

  • No reason shows on hover (the item is not blocked).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “By default 'Settings → Finance' is on for the Admin profile (required, cannot be turned off), Parts Manager and Office User, and off for Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Technician, Sales Representative and Time Clock User.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Out of the box, Move Customers is therefore available to Admin, Parts Manager and Office User; Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor and Sales Representative hold 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' but not 'Settings → Finance', so they cannot open the Credit Terms page.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "5 New Customer", "8 Over Credit warning" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
